newsitem.title: USA: Eight bidders in first US Stockpile platinum sale.
newsitem.headline: Eight bidders in first US Stockpile platinum sale.

text.p: Eight companies came forward to present bids on the first offer of U.S. Stockpile platinum made on Monday.
Any awards will be based on the London afternoon fix on the day after the bids were presented.
Fleet Precious Metals bid for 17 boxes at 98.25 percent of the London afternoon platinum fix price. Each box contains between 599 and 600 troy ounces.
A-1 Specialized bid for 17 boxes at 97.1 percent of the London afternoon fix.
J Aron and Co bid for 17 boxes at $365.25 an ounce.
Sabin Metal Corp bid for 17 boxes at 92.25 to 91.25 percent of the London afternoon fix.
Engelhard Corp bid for 17 boxes at 96.08 percent of the London fix.
Johnson Matthey bid for 17 boxes at 99.05 to 98.95 percent of the fix.
Gerald Metals bid for 17 boxes at 95.5 percent of the fix.
Degussa Corp bid for 17 boxes at 97.4686 percent of the fix.
In the current fiscal year the stockpile has authority to sell 10,188 ounces of platinum.
